items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: And so listen to it with Johnny Mathis way back and you’ll hear Tony Mottola in the background on that.

ctx.x: Is it a four thumps per measure or is it more of a two and four?

It’s according to if you’re doing it on a two and then to a four. Exactly. Right. But I would say on a ballad you would hear it more on the two and four. And so listen to it with Johnny Mathis way back and you’ll hear Tony Mottola in the background on that.
Like “Chances Are?” That kind of tune?
